info.text:
Nvidia touched about $5.7 trillion. Index funds own a slice.
Oct 2, 2026: shares hit a record high during trading, the first record since May.
End of 2022 it was worth about $360 billion, so it's now roughly 16x bigger.
Nvidia is about 8% of the S&P 500 (Sep 2026), so about $8 of every $100 in an S&P 500 index fund.
Sources: Bloomberg, CNBC, company buyback release, S&P 500 holdings data.
News and education, not financial advice.
